questions.stem: A certain metal sulphide, $M S_2$, is used extensively as a high temperature lubricant. If $\mathrm{MS}_2$ is $40.06 \%$ by mass sulphur, metal $M$ has atomic mass.
questions.solution: Taking the atomic mass of sulphur as $32$, its mass fraction in $MS_2$ is $64/(M+64)=0.4006$. Thus $M=64/0.4006-64\approx95.76\,\mathrm u$, giving the listed answer $96\,\mathrm u$.
